en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after allegedly slapping seven-year-old boy in Kwun Tong
en.dek: Police said a 37-year-old Filipino helper was detained after the boy’s mother reported the incident at a Hip Wo Street flat; the child had no visible injuries.
body: Police arrested a 37-year-old Filipino domestic helper on Saturday on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child after she allegedly slapped a seven-year-old boy in the face at a home in Kwun Tong.

Officers received a report from the boy’s mother at about 8:43am regarding an incident at a flat on Hip Wo Street. Preliminary investigation indicated the helper had used her palm to strike the boy’s face while caring for him. The boy reported pain in his nose but showed no superficial injuries and was conscious when taken to United Christian Hospital for examination.

The helper was detained for further investigation. The case has been passed to the Kwun Tong District Crime Squad Team 5. Police are looking into the motive and whether the helper has any similar record.

zh.headline: 觀塘外傭涉掌摛七歲男童被捕 警方調查虐兒
zh.dek: 警方表示，37歲菲律賓籍外傭在協和街單位涉嫌掌摛男童面部後被扣留調查，男童無表面傷痕。
body: 警方周六拘捕一名37歲菲律賓籍家庭傭工，涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略，她被指在觀塘住所掌摛一名七歲男童面部。
警員約早上8時43分接獲男童母親報案，指協和街一個單位發生事件。初步調查顯示，外傭在照顧男童期間曾以手掌擊打其面部。男童報稱鼻部疼痛，但無表面傷痕，清醒被送往聯合醫院檢查。
外傭已被扣留作進一步調查。案件交由觀塘警區刑事調查隊第五隊跟進。警方正了解動機，並查核外傭是否有類似紀錄。
